mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_record (exam_id, user_id, start_time, submit_time, score, total_score, correct_count, question_count, status, create_time) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{startTime}, #{submitTime}, #{score}, #{totalScore}, #{correctCount}, #{questionCount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
